settings.title: simple and effective tiles
settings.text: Attractive event flooring that is easy to install.

In four simple and fast steps, you can have your surface fully installed in minutes or less.

Getting Started

The panels have two sides with female PowerLocks, and two sides with male PowerLocks. All tiles on any given installation should always have the female PowerLocks going in the same direction.

Step One

Begin the installation by laying down your first panel in any one corner and pointing the female PowerLocks in the two directions that additional panels are to be added.

Step Two

Place the next panel so that the male PowerLock line up over the top of the female loops on the first panel. It's important to make sure that the female PowerLocks are facing exactly the same direction as the first panel.

Step Three

Gently step along the joint of the two panels. You will hear and feel the PowerLocks snap into place as you go.

Step Four

Once the two panels are joined, repeat steps one through three remembering to keep the female PowerLocks aligned until your floor is complete. That's all there is to this easy-to-install flooring!

settings.title: What are garage floor mats used for?
settings.text: Garage floor mats like the Floor Defender are designed to catch snow, mud, salt, oil, and other messes that vehicles bring into the garage. They help protect your garage floor from damage, reduce slip hazards, and keep the area clean.

settings.title: How are Floor Defender Garage Floor Mats different from regular mats?
settings.text: Unlike regular garage mats, Floor Defender Containment Mats have a built-in raised foam edge that traps liquids and debris. They are also made from durable, UV-coated vinyl that’s waterproof and rated for extreme temperatures.

settings.title: What’s the difference between the Regular and Pro versions?
settings.text: The Pro version has a tatami grain patterned backing for better grip, which helps reduce lifting and wrinkling. It’s ideal for garages where mats are used long-term or under frequent movement.

settings.title: Can I use these mats with studded tires or snow chains?
settings.text: No, we don’t recommend using the mats with studded tires or chains, as they can damage the vinyl surface and compromise the mat’s durability.

settings.title: How much liquid can these garage floor mats hold?
settings.text: The Car-size mat holds up to 62 gallons of liquid, while the Truck-size mat holds up to 70 gallons—enough to trap melting snow, rain, or vehicle runoff effectively.

settings.title: Are these mats slippery when wet?
settings.text: The mats are made with an anti-skid surface, but like any vinyl product, they can become slippery when wet. Use caution when walking or driving over a wet mat.

settings.title: How do I clean the mat?
settings.text: Simply drag the mat outside and rinse it off with a hose. For stubborn dirt or oil, use a mild detergent. Avoid harsh chemicals like bleach or solvents.

settings.title: Can I use these garage floor mats on any surface?
settings.text: They are designed for use on smooth, flat surfaces such as concrete or epoxy garage floors. Avoid placing the mat on uneven or rough surfaces.

settings.title: Do the wrinkles in the mat go away?
settings.text: Yes, wrinkles caused by shipping will relax over time. Warm temperatures help speed up the process. You can also mop with hot water or use a hair dryer to reduce wrinkles faster.
